description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Uro.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Uro dies, Havi and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
